body.text: R&B Rebels Goals: Teach gospel influence + image building. “How does this sound like church but also… not church at ALL?”

All raised in church, heavy gospel training
Moved to NYC with demo tapes → signed by Uptown Records
Brought leather, boots, and bad-boy swagger into R&B
